rows.corpus_definition: A person who lives alone, away from others.
rows.example_en: The hermit lived alone in the cave.

rows.corpus_definition: Very brave and showing great courage in difficult situations.
rows.example_en: The soldier made a heroic effort to save his friend.

rows.corpus_definition: A woman who is admired for her brave actions or character.
rows.example_en: She is the heroine of this famous adventure story.

rows.corpus_definition: To make it hard for someone to do something.
rows.example_en: Bad weather will hinder our travel plans.

rows.corpus_definition: An expert who studies the events of the past.
rows.example_en: The historian wrote about ancient Rome.

rows.corpus_definition: To travel by asking drivers for a free ride.
rows.example_en: They decided to hitchhike across the country.

rows.corpus_definition: A long, loud, sad sound made by an animal.
rows.example_en: We heard the wolf howl at night.

rows.corpus_definition: Not doing anything or having no work to do.
rows.example_en: It is not good to remain idle all day.

rows.corpus_definition: Not knowing about a specific topic.
rows.example_en: He was ignorant of the new company rules.

rows.corpus_definition: Something that seems real but is not.
rows.example_en: The mirror created an illusion of a larger room.
